steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist and update titles.
from collections import Counter

access_token = login_result['access_token']

for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    original_title = pl['title']
    song_ids = pl['song_ids']
    # Tally genres
    genre_counts = Counter(song_genres[sid] for sid in song_ids)
    # Find most common; if tie, pick the one with highest count, then alphabetically first
    max_count = max(genre_counts.values())
    # Get all genres with max count, sort alphabetically, pick first
    top_genres = sorted([g for g, c in genre_counts.items() if c == max_count])
    most_common = top_genres[0]
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl_id}: '{original_title}' -> '{new_title}'")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
    print(result)
